title: ClickHouse person tombstones and repair utilities
answers: How to undo or repair tombstoned distinct ids?
body:
- posthog/models/person/util.py:`delete_person` → `_delete_person` → `create_person(..., is_deleted=True, version=version+100)` and `_delete_ch_distinct_id` per distinct id (`create_person_distinct_id(is_deleted=True)`).
- The +100 makes the tombstone win ReplacingMergeTree merges; a code comment says it must stay in sync with plugin-server `generateKafkaPersonUpdateMessage`, and `split_person` uses +101.
- `_get_distinct_ids_with_version` fallback (when not prefetched) is racy (issue 11590).
- `delete_persons_from_postgres` is separate: personhog `delete_persons` RPC, batches of 1000.
- posthog/models/person/deletion.py: `reset_all_deleted_person_distinct_ids`/`reset_deleted_person_distinct_ids` un-tombstone via higher version (2500); `find_orphaned_ch_persons`/`tombstone_orphaned_ch_persons` fix PG-missing-but-CH-live drift (`OrphanRepairResult`; reverse drift reported, not repaired).
applies: Tombstone version bump applies to ClickHouse person/person_distinct_id2 rows only; Postgres rows are hard-deleted.
